name: Public reading experience, search and shareable articles
description: Checks the core public reading experience from feed through opening and sharing a story.
steps: Open the AdEarn homepage
Wait for stories to load
Search for renewable and select Technology
Open a story and verify the title and description update
Use Share story and open the resulting article URL in a new tab
expected: Published stories load, filters work, and a shared article URL opens the correct story with dynamic page metadata.

name: Secure publisher CMS and AI editorial studio
description: Checks only the allowlisted publisher can manage articles and use the AI drafting and optimization tools.
steps: Open Admin while signed out and verify the sign-in gate
Sign in with the configured administrator email
Create and edit a draft article, then verify it persists
Open AI Studio and generate a draft from a topic
Move the AI draft into the editor and verify it is not auto-published
Run the editorial review on the article
Delete the test article
expected: Admin APIs remain protected; content persists; AI returns an editable draft and never publishes automatically.

name: AdSense configuration and placement compliance
covers: Google AdSense is the only configured advertising provider
test preview clearly distinguished from real Google-served ads
live Google responsive ad unit integration
live ad activation requires valid publisher and ad unit IDs
disabled placements do not load ad units
no forced clicks or incentivized traffic
description: Checks the publisher can configure valid ad placement IDs and that incomplete configuration does not activate ads.
steps: Open Admin and sign in
Open Advertising
Select Simulation mode and enable ad placements
Inspect the clearly labelled Google AdSense test preview and verify it is not presented as a real advertiser campaign
Try to enable live mode without valid Google IDs and verify the server rejects the configuration
Enter a valid Google AdSense publisher ID and at least one ad unit ID, enable Live mode and save
Return to Discover and inspect the configured labelled placements
expected: AdEarn exposes Google AdSense only; test previews are explicitly non-advertising placeholders with no Google request or revenue, live mode rejects invalid IDs, and eligible live placements request Google AdSense responsive units only.

name: Newsletter and audience management
description: Checks visitors can subscribe and save stories, while the administrator can manage subscriber and contact records.
steps: Subscribe using a valid email
Save a story and refresh the reading list
Sign in as administrator and open Audience
Review subscribers and export CSV
Resolve a test contact message
expected: Newsletter and reading-list actions persist; subscriber and message records are visible only to the administrator.

name: Graceful handling of API failures
description: Checks API errors are visible and do not crash the publication.
steps: Open the homepage while the article API failure is injected
expected: A clear error message and Try again control are shown instead of a blank page.
